notes: Read all 105 source lines line by line before editing and preserved the LegendPayloadEntry dataKey fallback logic, ChartLegendToggleSource toggle/isHidden surface, ChartLegendProps state/wrapperStyle/verticalAlign/align props, and ChartLegend export.

Converted the Recharts Legend formatter/onClick behavior to React Native View/Pressable/AppText primitives so supplied native legend payload entries can still toggle hidden series and render the 40% opacity plus line-through hidden state.
Kept context fallback through useChartHiddenSeries so ChartContainer chartKey state still drives legends when no explicit state prop is supplied.

Recharts auto-generated legend payload and DOM span data attributes are unavailable in React Native; the port documents this by exposing a native-only payload prop and rendering an explicit unavailable message when no payload is provided.
